description: Generate multi-speaker dialogue using ElevenLabs Text-to-Dialogue V3 via kie.ai. Great for conversations between characters. Downloads to kie/assets/raw/.

dialogue.description: Array of dialogue lines with voice assignments

voice.description: Voice name (e.g. "Bella") or kie voice ID for this speaker — kie.ai only accepts its curated voice set; unknown values return the full catalog

download_dir.description: Absolute directory to save the file(s) into (created if missing). Defaults to the server's kie/assets/raw/. Must be absolute — the MCP server's working directory is not the caller's.

estimate_only.description: Return the estimated credit cost WITHOUT submitting anything. Use before expensive runs (video, 4K, 1080p upgrades, layer splits).

max_credits.description: Refuse to submit if the estimated cost exceeds this many credits (overrides KIE_MAX_CREDITS_PER_CALL). Estimates come from published rates; kie bills the actual amount.

max_wait_seconds.description: Override the blocking-mode polling budget in seconds (defaults: image 600, video 900, audio 300, speech 300). Ignored when wait=false.

stability.description: Voice stability — kie accepts exactly 0 (creative), 0.5 (natural), or 1 (robust)

wait.description: Set false to submit and return immediately with the task_id (async mode) — then poll with check_task and fetch with download_result. Recommended for long generations to avoid client-side watchdog timeouts.

name: generate_dialogue
